experience.summary: Designing and operating data systems for the manufacturing floor: real-time ETL from PLCs, dashboards, AI-driven quality control, and a full traceability platform.

Full-time. Built ETL pipelines, Data Warehouse, Data Lake, Data Lakehouse, crawlers, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD. Led the team building the Data Lakehouse and a Modern Data Platform (ETL batch + streaming) with Data Visualization in Grafana.

projects.name: GembaBoard — Manufacturing Data Visualization System
projects.summary: Web-based system for real-time monitoring and historical analysis of production data, enabling immediate operational decisions and long-term improvement strategies.
highlights: Engineered an ETL pipeline in Python to automatically extract raw operational data from machine PLCs.
Cleansing, transformation and normalization into SQL Server to ensure data integrity for in-depth analytics.
Built a responsive Node web app with dynamic dashboards (operation rate, output volume, trouble listings) plus Excel/chart export.
v2 AI upgrade: integrated a Cyber-Physical System (CCTV + YOLOv8) to detect operator procedural violations in real-time with automated alerts.

projects.name: Production AI Chatbot — Factory Operations Assistant
projects.summary: In-house AI Chatbot serving as a virtual assistant for Production, HR and Maintenance — streamlines information access and operational support.
highlights: Deployed Llama 3.1 and fine-tuned on proprietary SOPs, machine manuals, HR policies and historical production data.
Python backend handling core logic, sessions and LLM interaction.
Node chat UI with natural-language querying.
Use cases: order status & machine efficiency (Production), step-by-step troubleshooting (Maintenance), policy lookups (HR).

projects.name: Gap–OC Test Machine Automation & Optimization
projects.summary: Intelligent automation that optimizes the testing process between GAP and OC Test machines to maximize OK Rate.
highlights: Python module over Modbus TCP/IP acquiring real-time parameters from the GAP machine's PLC.
Algorithm matching and synchronizing data per product as it moves from GAP to OC Test.
Statistical / trend analysis to correlate GAP inputs with final OC outcomes.
Closed-loop system: autonomously recommends optimized GAP PLC parameter adjustments.

projects.name: Data Traceability System — End-to-End Product Lifecycle Tracking
projects.summary: Full-stack traceability platform capturing the complete production lifecycle of every unique product for QA, RCA and long-term compliance.
highlights: Ingestion pipeline triggered by QR scans at multiple stations (T-S, OC Test). Warehoused in SQL Server with 4+ years retention (ISO compliance).
Node.js/Express web app with instant search-by-serial and step-by-step OK/NG/Rework history.
Strict compliance with data security protocols and Panasonic's internal ISM standards.
Built core Rework & Scrap modules (with image capture) plus analytics dashboards: real-time NG rates, rework volumes, scrap counts.
